name: capabilities
intro: The capabilities a role grants in OpenCRQ, as the role editors name them. A tenant role grants its capabilities in its tenant only; a platform role grants the platform's. A capability reaches a person through a group: a group holds roles; a user belongs to groups of its tenants and to platform groups, a service account to groups of its own tenant only, so it never holds a platform capability. The super administrator XTM One designates holds every capability, in every tenant and on the platform, without a group. A new platform starts with these platform roles, each in a group with no member yet: **Platform administrator** (every platform capability), in **Platform administrators**; **User manager** (**Manage Users** and **Platform Administration Access**), in **User managers**. Each new tenant gets an **Admin** role and group with every tenant capability.

sections.title: Tenant capabilities
sections.text: Granted by the roles of a tenant (the tenant's **Settings > Security > Roles**).

cells: Manage users, groups, roles and their capabilities.

sections.title: Platform capabilities
sections.text: Granted by the roles of the platform (the platform's **Settings > Security > Roles**).
